verses.english: “Mendicants, three things are conveyed under cover, not in the open.

verses.pali: Mātugāmo, bhikkhave, paṭicchanno āvahati, no vivaṭo;
verses.english: Females are married with a veil, not unveiled.

verses.pali: brāhmaṇānaṁ, bhikkhave, mantā paṭicchannā āvahanti, no vivaṭā;
verses.english: Brahmin hymns are conveyed under cover, not openly.

verses.pali: micchādiṭṭhi, bhikkhave, paṭicchannā āvahati, no vivaṭā.
verses.english: Wrong view is conveyed under cover, not in the open.

verses.pali: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi paṭicchannāni āvahanti, no vivaṭāni.
verses.english: These three things are conveyed under cover, not in the open.

verses.pali: Tīṇimāni, bhikkhave, vivaṭāni virocanti, no paṭicchannāni.
verses.english: Three things shine in the open, not under cover.

verses.pali: Candamaṇḍalaṁ, bhikkhave, vivaṭaṁ virocati, no paṭicchannaṁ;
verses.english: The moon shines in the open, not under cover.

verses.pali: sūriyamaṇḍalaṁ, bhikkhave, vivaṭaṁ virocati, no paṭicchannaṁ;
verses.english: The sun shines in the open, not under cover.

verses.pali: tathāgatappavedito dhammavinayo, bhikkhave, vivaṭo virocati, no paṭicchanno.
verses.english: The teaching and training proclaimed by a Realized One shine in the open, not under cover.

verses.pali: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi vivaṭāni virocanti, no paṭicchannānī”ti.
verses.english: These three things shine in the open, not under cover.”
